  window.addEventListener("message", function(e) {
    if (typeof e.data !== "string" || e.data.indexOf("Tally.FormSubmitted") === -1) return;
    var payload;

<!-- Plausible journey events: delegated CTA click tracking.
     Primary: data-track="trial" attribute on CTAs (self-documenting, works
     for any href). Fallback: href matching for CTAs that haven't been tagged
     yet. Capture phase so stopPropagation on the demo page can't swallow it.

     data-track="trial"     → fires "Trial: CTA Click"
     data-placement="hero"  → props.placement (hero|nav|footer|section)
     No data-placement      → inferred from DOM ancestors               -->
<script>
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href],button') : null;
    if (!el) return;
    var href = el.getAttribute('href') || '';
    var track = el.getAttribute('data-track');

    /* ── Placement: explicit attribute wins, then DOM inference ── */
    var placement = el.getAttribute('data-placement')
      || (el.closest('.mn-nav') ? 'nav'
        : el.closest('.sf-footer,.page_liner-block') ? 'footer'
        : el.closest('[class*="hero"],.sh-cta,.ph-hero,.ov-hero,.pp-hero') ? 'hero'
        : 'section');

    /* ── Trial CTA ── */
    var isTrial = track === 'trial'
      || href.indexOf('ai.synup.com/signup') !== -1
      || href.indexOf('synupbot.com/signup') !== -1;

    if (isTrial) {
      plausible('Trial: CTA Click', {
        props: { location: location.pathname, placement: placement }
      });
      return;
    }

    /* ── Sales / Contact CTAs (unchanged logic) ── */
    var props = { page: location.pathname, section: placement };

    if (/(^|\/)((es|fr|de)\/)?(book-a-demo(-social)?|contact-sales)(\/|$|\?|#)/.test(href)) {
      plausible('Contact Sales Clicked', { props: props });
    } else if (/(^|\/)((es|fr|de)\/)?contact(\/|$|\?|#)/.test(href)) {
      plausible('Contact Clicked', { props: props });
    }
  }, true);
</script>

  min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px;              /* was ~40px — now a full 44x44 touch target */
  background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: .5rem; color: var(--mn-navy);
}
.mn-burger svg { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; }
.mn-burger .mn-x { display: none; }

/* ---------- Panel ---------- */
.mn-panel-host { position: relative; }
.mn-panel {
  display: none; background: var(--mn-white);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--mn-line);
}
.mn-panel.is-open { display: block; }
.mn-panel-inner {
  max-width: var(--mn-maxw); margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 1.75rem 2.25rem;
}

/* Panel grids */
.mn-panel-grid { display: grid; gap: 2.5rem; }
.mn-cols-agent    { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.mn-cols-product  { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.mn-cols-solutions{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.mn-cols-resources{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }

.mn-group-heading {
  font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-bottom: 1rem;
}
.mn-item-list { display: grid; gap: .25rem; }
.mn-mega-item {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.25rem 1fr; gap: .875rem;
  align-items: start; padding: .625rem; border-radius: 10px;
  transition: background .12s ease; text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
}
.mn-mega-item:active { background: var(--mn-bg-soft); }   /* tap feedback; :hover is in the hover-only block */
.mn-mega-tile {
  width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--mn-bg-soft);
  display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--mn-navy); flex: none;
  transition: background .12s ease, color .12s ease;
}
.mn-mega-tile svg { width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; }
.mn-mega-text { min-width: 0; }                   /* prevents an unbreakable label from overflowing */
.mn-mega-text .mn-mt-label {
  font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--mn-navy); line-height: 1.3;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
}
.mn-mt-desc { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--mn-muted); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: .125rem; }
.mn-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
  font-size: .625rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em;
  color: #fff; background: var(--mn-orange); border-radius: 200px;
  padding: .125rem .4375rem; line-height: 1.4;
}

/* Feature card */
.mn-feature-card {
  background: var(--mn-bg-soft); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; align-self: start;
  border: 1px solid var(--mn-line);
}
.mn-fc-media {
  position: relative; border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden; height: 8rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1C1917, #C2410C);
  display: grid; place-items: center;
}
.mn-fc-play {
  width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--mn-navy);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
.mn-fc-play svg { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; margin-left: 2px; }
.mn-fc-eyebrow { font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--mn-muted); }
.mn-fc-title { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-navy); line-height: 1.3; }
.mn-fc-link { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--mn-blue); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .375rem; }
.mn-fc-link svg { width: .9375rem; height: .9375rem; }

/* Suite grid (Product v2) */
.mn-suite-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3.5rem; }
.mn-suite { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }
.mn-suite-divider { position: relative; }
.mn-suite-divider::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: -1.75rem; width: 1px; background: var(--mn-line); }
.mn-anchor { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 1.5rem; }
.mn-anchor-card {
  position: relative; display: block; border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.375rem 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--mn-line); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF1E8 0%, #FCFBF9 100%);
  overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow .15s ease, transform .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
  text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
}
.mn-anchor-card::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -10%; width: 14rem; height: 14rem;
  border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,115,30,.15), transparent 68%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.mn-anchor-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .625rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.mn-anchor-eyebrow { font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--mn-blue); }
.mn-anchor-title { position: relative; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-navy); line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.mn-anchor-sub { position: relative; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--mn-muted); line-height: 1.45; margin-top: .375rem; max-width: 26rem; }
.mn-anchor-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .375rem; margin-top: .875rem; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-blue); }
.mn-anchor-link svg { width: .9375rem; height: .9375rem; transition: transform .15s ease; }

/* ---------- Hover states: real pointers only (kills sticky-hover on touch) ---------- */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .mn-link:hover { background: var(--mn-bg-soft); color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-signin:hover { color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-btn-primary:hover { background: #292524; }
  .mn-mega-item:hover { background: var(--mn-bg-soft); }
  .mn-mega-item:hover .mn-mega-tile { background: #FFF1E8; color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-mega-item:hover .mn-mt-label { color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-anchor-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -14px rgba(194,65,12,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--mn-line); }
  .mn-anchor-card:hover .mn-anchor-link { color: var(--mn-blue-hover); }
  .mn-anchor-card:hover .mn-anchor-link svg { transform: translateX(3px); }
}

/* ---------- Mobile ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .mn-links { display: none; }
  .mn-signin { display: none; }
  .mn-burger { display: flex; align-items: center; }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-links {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch;
    position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 9998;
    background: var(--mn-white); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mn-line);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
    padding: 1rem 1.75rem;
    /* env(): menu edges clear the notch; bottom clears the home indicator */
    padding-left:  max(1.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-left));
    padding-right: max(1.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-right));
    padding-bottom: max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    /* tall menu scrolls inside the viewport instead of hiding behind the browser chrome.
       dvh handles the iOS URL bar; the vh line above is the fallback for old browsers. */
    max-height: calc(100vh - 4rem);
    max-height: calc(100dvh - 4rem);
    overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-burger .mn-menu { display: none; }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-burger .mn-x { display: block; }
  .mn-panel { position: relative; }
  .mn-panel-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .mn-cols-agent, .mn-cols-product, .mn-cols-solutions, .mn-cols-resources { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .mn-suite-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .mn-suite-divider::before { display: none; }
  .mn-feature-card { display: none; }
  /* Mobile menu: show items two-up so the list is shorter to scan/scroll.
     Drop the per-item descriptions in this compact 2-col view. */

  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-mega-item { padding: .5rem .5rem; }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-mt-desc { display: none; }
}

<script>
(function(){
  var nav = document.querySelector("[data-mn]");
  if (!nav) return;
  var links = nav.querySelectorAll("[data-mn-link]");
  var panels = nav.querySelectorAll("[data-mn-panel]");
  var burger = nav.querySelector("[data-mn-burger]");
  var host = nav.querySelector(".mn-panel-host");
  var active = null;
  var lastInputWasPointer = false;

  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(){ lastInputWasPointer = true; }, true);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(){ lastInputWasPointer = false; }, true);

  function open(name) {
    panels.forEach(function(p){ p.classList.toggle("is-open", p.getAttribute("data-mn-panel") === name); });
    links.forEach(function(l){ l.classList.toggle("is-open", l.getAttribute("data-mn-link") === name); });
    active = name;
  }
  function closeAll() {
    panels.forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove("is-open"); });
    links.forEach(function(l){ l.classList.remove("is-open"); });
    active = null;
  }

  // Only bind hover-open on real pointers. On touch, a synthesized mouseenter would
  // open the panel and the following click would toggle it shut ("won't open" bug).
  var canHover = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and (min-width: 1025px)").matches;

  links.forEach(function(l){
    if (canHover) l.addEventListener("mouseenter", function(){ open(l.getAttribute("data-mn-link")); });
    l.addEventListener("focus", function(){
      // A tap focuses before it clicks. Let the click open the panel so the
      // newly restored Resources item remains reachable on touch devices.
      if (!lastInputWasPointer) open(l.getAttribute("data-mn-link"));
    });
    l.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var name = l.getAttribute("data-mn-link");
      if (active === name) closeAll(); else open(name);
    });
  });

  if (canHover) host.addEventListener("mouseleave", closeAll);

  if (burger) {
    burger.addEventListener("click", function(){ nav.classList.toggle("is-open"); closeAll(); });
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", function(e){
    if (!nav.contains(e.target)) { closeAll(); nav.classList.remove("is-open"); }
  });
})();

<script>
// image-slot.js inlined
(() => {
  const STATE_FILE = '.image-slots.state.json';

  const UNSPLASH_HOMEPAGE_HREF =
    'https://unsplash.com/?utm_source=claude_design&utm_medium=referral';
  const isUnsplashHost = (u) => {
    try {
      return /(^|\.)unsplash\.com$/.test(
        new URL(u, document.baseURI).hostname.replace(/\.$/, '')
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  };
  const withReferral = (href) => {
    try {
      const u = new URL(href);
      if (!/(^|\.)unsplash\.com$/.test(u.hostname.replace(/\.$/, ''))) {
        return href;
      }
      if (!u.searchParams.has('utm_source')) {
        u.searchParams.set('utm_source', 'claude_design');
      }
      if (!u.searchParams.has('utm_medium')) {
        u.searchParams.set('utm_medium', 'referral');
      }
      return u.toString();
    } catch (e) {
      return href;
    }
  };
  const MAX_DIM = 1200;
  const ACCEPT = ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'image/avif'];

  const subs = new Set();
  let slots = {};
  const tombstones = new Set();
  let loaded = false;
  let loadP = null;

  function load() {
    if (loadP) return loadP;
    loadP = fetch(STATE_FILE)
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((j) => {
        if (j && typeof j === 'object') {
          const merged = Object.assign({}, j, slots);
          for (const k in slots) {
            if (merged[k] && !merged[k].u && j[k]) {
              merged[k].u = typeof j[k] === 'string' ? j[k] : j[k].u;
            }
          }
          for (const id of tombstones) delete merged[id];
          slots = merged;
        }
        tombstones.clear();
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .then(() => { loaded = true; subs.forEach((fn) => fn()); });
    return loadP;
  }

  let saving = false;
  let saveDirty = false;
  function flushNow() {
    if (!loaded) return;
    const w = window.omelette && window.omelette.writeFile;
    if (!w) return;
    try { Promise.resolve(w(STATE_FILE, JSON.stringify(slots))).catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function save() {
    if (saving) { saveDirty = true; return; }
    const w = window.omelette && window.omelette.writeFile;
    if (!w) return;
    saving = true;
    Promise.resolve(w(STATE_FILE, JSON.stringify(slots)))
      .catch(() => {})
      .then(() => { saving = false; if (saveDirty) { saveDirty = false; save(); } });
  }

  const S_MAX = 5;
  const clampS = (s) => Math.max(1, Math.min(S_MAX, s));

  function getSlot(id) {
    const v = slots[id];
    if (!v) return null;
    return typeof v === 'string' ? { u: v, s: 1, x: 0, y: 0 } : v;
  }

  function setSlot(id, val) {
    if (!id) return;
    if (val) { slots[id] = val; tombstones.delete(id); }
    else { delete slots[id]; if (!loaded) tombstones.add(id); }
    subs.forEach((fn) => fn());
    if (loaded) save(); else load().then(save);
  }

  async function toDataUrl(file, targetW) {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
    try {
      const cap = Math.min(MAX_DIM, Math.max(1, Math.round(targetW * 2)) || MAX_DIM);
      const scale = Math.min(1, cap / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
      const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale));
      const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale));
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
      canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, w, h);
      return canvas.toDataURL('image/webp', 0.85);
    } finally {
      bitmap.close && bitmap.close();
    }
  }

  const stylesheet =

    '.loading::after{content:"";width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;' +
    '  border:2px solid rgba(127,127,127,.25);border-top-color:currentColor;' +
    '  animation:om-slot-spin .7s linear infinite}' +
    '@keyframes om-slot-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}' +
    '@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.loading::after{animation:none}}' +
    '.credit{position:absolute;left:6px;bottom:6px;max-width:calc(100% - 12px);display:none;' +
    '  padding:3px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;' +
    '  font:10px/1.2 system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;' +
    '  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}' +
    '.credit a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}' +
    '.credit a:hover,.credit a:focus-visible{text-decoration:underline}' +
    ':host([data-filled][data-credit]) .credit{display:block}' +
    ':host-context([data-om-exporting]) .ctl,' +
    ':host-context([data-om-exporting]) .credit{display:none !important}' +

    '.attr-error svg{opacity:.55}' +

    ':host([data-attribution-error]) .ring{display:none}';

  const icon =
    '<svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" ' +
    'stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
    '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/>' +
    '<path d="m21 15-5-5L5 21"/></svg>';

  const warnIcon =
    '<svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" ' +
    'stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
    '<path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.46 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3"/>' +
    '<path d="M12 9v4"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/></svg>';

  class ImageSlot extends HTMLElement {
    static get observedAttributes() {
      return ['shape', 'radius', 'mask', 'fit', 'placeholder', 'src', 'id', 'credit', 'credit-href'];
    }

    static cloneSlot(fromId, isFree) {
      if (typeof fromId !== 'string' || !fromId) return null;
      if (!loaded) return null;
      const stem = fromId.replace(/-\d+$/, '') || fromId;
      for (let n = 2; n < 100; n++) {
        const toId = stem + '-' + n;
        if (toId === fromId) continue;
        if (slots[toId] !== undefined) {
          const prev = getSlot(toId);
          const cur = getSlot(fromId);
          if (!(prev && cur && prev.u && prev.u === cur.u &&
                prev.s === cur.s && prev.x === cur.x && prev.y === cur.y &&
                (typeof isFree !== 'function' || isFree(toId)))) continue;
          return toId;
        }
        if (typeof isFree === 'function' && !isFree(toId)) continue;
        const v = getSlot(fromId);
        if (v) setSlot(toId, Object.assign({}, v));
        return toId;
      }
      return null;
    }

    constructor() {
      super();
      const root = this.shadowRoot ||
        this.attachShadow({ mode: 'open', clonable: true });
      root.innerHTML =
        '<style>' + stylesheet + '</style>' +
        '<div class="frame" part="frame">' +
        '  <img part="image" alt="" draggable="false" style="display:none">' +
        '  <div class="empty" part="empty">' + icon +
        '    <div class="cap"></div>' +
        '    <div class="sub">or <u>browse files</u></div></div>' +
        '  <div class="attr-error" part="attribution-error">' + warnIcon +
        '    <div class="cap">This photo needs attribution</div></div>' +
        '  <div class="loading" part="loading"></div>' +
        '  <div class="ring" part="ring"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<span class="credit" part="credit"></span>' +
        '<div class="spill" popover="manual" data-dc-edit-transparent>' +
        '  <img class="ghost" alt="" draggable="false">' +
        '  <div class="handle" data-c="nw"></div><div class="handle" data-c="ne"></div>' +
        '  <div class="handle" data-c="sw"></div><div class="handle" data-c="se"></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ctl" popover="manual" data-dc-edit-transparent><button data-act="replace" title="Replace image">Replace</button>' +
        '  <button data-act="edit" title="Reframe image">Edit</button></div>' +
        '<input type="file" accept="' + ACCEPT.join(',') + '" hidden>';
      this._frame = root.querySelector('.frame');
      this._ring = root.querySelector('.ring');
      this._img = root.querySelector('.frame img');
      this._empty = root.querySelector('.empty');
      this._cap = root.querySelector('.cap');
      this._sub = root.querySelector('.sub');
      this._spill = root.querySelector('.spill');
      this._ctl = root.querySelector('.ctl');
      this._credit = root.querySelector('.credit');
      this._attrError = root.querySelector('.attr-error');
      this._credit.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
      this._credit.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
      this._ghost = root.querySelector('.ghost');
      this._err = null;
      this._input = root.querySelector('input');
      this._depth = 0;
      this._gen = 0;
      this._swapGen = 0;
      this._loadPending = false;
      this._hidShowing = false;
      this._view = { s: 1, x: 0, y: 0 };
      this._subFn = () => this._render();
      this._empty.addEventListener('click', () => this._input.click());
      root.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const act = e.target && e.target.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-act');
        if (!act) return;
        if (!this.hasAttribute('data-editable')) return;
        if (act === 'replace') {
          this._exitReframe(true);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('image-slot:pick', {
            bubbles: true, composed: true, detail: { id: this.id || null }
          }));
        }
        if (act === 'edit') {
          if (!this._reframes()) return;
          if (this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) this._exitReframe(true);
          else this._enterReframe();
        }
      });
      this._input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const f = this._input.files && this._input.files[0];
        if (f) this._ingest(f);
        this._input.value = '';
      });
      this._img.addEventListener('load', () => {
        this._loadPending = false;
        this._releaseMask(true);
        this._applyView();
      });
      this._img.addEventListener('error', () => {
        this._loadPending = false;
        this._releaseMask(true);
      });
      this.addEventListener('dblclick', (e) => {
        if (!this.hasAttribute('data-editable') || !this._reframes()) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) this._exitReframe(true);
        else this._enterReframe();
      });
      this._spill.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0 || !this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        this._spill.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
        const fw = rect.width || 1, fh = rect.height || 1;
        const corner = e.target.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-c');
        let move;
        if (corner) {
          const iw = this._img.naturalWidth || 1, ih = this._img.naturalHeight || 1;
          const contain = (this.getAttribute('fit') || 'cover').toLowerCase() === 'contain';
          const base = contain ? Math.min(fw / iw, fh / ih) : Math.max(fw / iw, fh / ih);
          const sx = corner.includes('e') ? 1 : -1;
          const sy = corner.includes('s') ? 1 : -1;
          const s0 = this._view.s;
          const w0 = iw * base * s0, h0 = ih * base * s0;
          const cx0 = (50 + this._view.x) / 100 * fw;
          const cy0 = (50 + this._view.y) / 100 * fh;
          const ox = cx0 - sx * w0 / 2, oy = cy0 - sy * h0 / 2;
          const diag0 = Math.hypot(w0, h0);
          const ux = sx * w0 / diag0, uy = sy * h0 / diag0;
          move = (ev) => {
            const proj = (ev.clientX - rect.left - ox) * ux +
                         (ev.clientY - rect.top - oy) * uy;
            const s = clampS(s0 * proj / diag0);
            const d = diag0 * s / s0;
            this._view.s = s;
            this._view.x = (ox + ux * d / 2) / fw * 100 - 50;
            this._view.y = (oy + uy * d / 2) / fh * 100 - 50;
            this._clampView();
            this._applyView();
          };
        } else {
          this.setAttribute('data-panning', '');
          const start = { px: e.clientX, py: e.clientY, x: this._view.x, y: this._view.y };
          move = (ev) => {
            this._view.x = start.x + (ev.clientX - start.px) / fw * 100;
            this._view.y = start.y + (ev.clientY - start.py) / fh * 100;
            this._clampView();
            this._applyView();
          };
        }
        const up = () => {
          try { this._spill.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch {}
          this._spill.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
          this._spill.removeEventListener('pointerup', up);
          this._spill.removeEventListener('pointercancel', up);
          this.removeAttribute('data-panning');
          this._dragUp = null;
        };
        this._dragUp = up;
        this._spill.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
        this._spill.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
        this._spill.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
      });
      this.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        if (!this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const r = this.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * 100 - 50;
        const cy = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * 100 - 50;
        const prev = this._view.s;
        const next = clampS(prev * Math.pow(1.0015, -e.deltaY));
        if (next === prev) return;
        const k = next / prev;
        this._view.s = next;
        this._view.x = cx * (1 - k) + this._view.x * k;
        this._view.y = cy * (1 - k) + this._view.y * k;
        this._clampView();
        this._applyView();
      }, { passive: false });
    }

    connectedCallback() {
      if (!this.id && !ImageSlot._warned) {
        ImageSlot._warned = true;
        console.warn('<image-slot> without an id will not persist its dropped image.');
      }
      this.addEventListener('dragenter', this);
      this.addEventListener('dragover', this);
      this.addEventListener('dragleave', this);
      this.addEventListener('drop', this);
      subs.add(this._subFn);
      this.addEventListener('pointerenter', this._subFn);
      this._ro = new ResizeObserver(() => this._render());
      this._ro.observe(this);
      load();
      this._render();
    }

    disconnectedCallback() {
      subs.delete(this._subFn);
      this.removeEventListener('pointerenter', this._subFn);
      this.removeEventListener('dragenter', this);
      this.removeEventListener('dragover', this);
      this.removeEventListener('dragleave', this);
      this.removeEventListener('drop', this);
      if (this._ro) { this._ro.disconnect(); this._ro = null; }
      this._exitReframe(false);
    }

    _enterReframe() {
      if (this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) return;
      this.setAttribute('data-reframe', '');
      this._signalReframe(true);
      this._pagehide = () => { this._exitReframe(true); flushNow(); };
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', this._pagehide);
      try { this._spill.showPopover(); } catch {}
      try { this._ctl.showPopover(); } catch {}
      this._reposition = () => { if (this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) this._applyView(); };
      window.addEventListener('scroll', this._reposition, true);
      window.addEventListener('resize', this._reposition);
      this._lastRect = '';
      this._watch = () => {
        if (!this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) return;
        const r = this.getBoundingClientRect();
        const key = r.left + ',' + r.top + ',' + r.width + ',' + r.height;
        if (key !== this._lastRect) { this._lastRect = key; this._applyView(); }
        this._watchId = requestAnimationFrame(this._watch);
      };
      this._watchId = requestAnimationFrame(this._watch);
      this._applyView();
      this._outside = (e) => {

      };
      this._esc = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') this._exitReframe(true); };

      document.addEventListener('keydown', this._esc, true);
    }

    _exitReframe(commit) {
      if (!this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) return;
      if (this._dragUp) this._dragUp();
      this.removeAttribute('data-reframe');
      this.removeAttribute('data-panning');
      if (this._outside) document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', this._outside, true);
      if (this._esc) document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._esc, true);
      this._outside = this._esc = null;
      if (this._reposition) {
        window.removeEventListener('scroll', this._reposition, true);
        window.removeEventListener('resize', this._reposition);
        this._reposition = null;
      }
      if (this._watchId) { cancelAnimationFrame(this._watchId); this._watchId = 0; }

        window.removeEventListener('pagehide', this._pagehide);

      }

      try { this._ctl.hidePopover(); } catch {}

    _signalReframe(active) {

      target.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('image-slot:reframe', {
        bubbles: true, composed: true,
        detail: { active: active, id: this.id || null }
      }));
    }

    openFilePicker() { this._exitReframe(true); this._input.click(); }

    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
      if (name === 'src' && oldVal !== newVal) {
        this._gen++;
        this._swapGen = 0;
      }
      if (this.shadowRoot) this._render();
    }

    handleEvent(e) {
      if (e.type === 'dragenter' || e.type === 'dragover') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

      } else if (e.type === 'dragleave') {
        if (--this._depth <= 0) { this._depth = 0; this.removeAttribute('data-over'); }
      } else if (e.type === 'drop') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

    async _ingest(file) {
      this._setError(null);
      if (!file || ACCEPT.indexOf(file.type) < 0) {
        this._setError('Drop a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or AVIF image.');
        return;
      }
      const gen = ++this._gen;
      if (this.hasAttribute('data-filled')) {
        this.setAttribute('data-swapping', '');
        this._swapGen = gen;
      }
      try {
        const w = this.clientWidth || this.offsetWidth || MAX_DIM;
        const url = await toDataUrl(file, w);
        if (gen !== this._gen) return;
        this._exitReframe(false);
        this._swapGen = 0;
        const val = { u: url, s: 1, x: 0, y: 0 };
        setSlot(this.id || '', val);
        if (!this.id) { this._local = val; this._render(); }
      } catch (err) {
        if (gen !== this._gen) return;
        this._swapGen = 0;
        this._releaseMask();

        console.warn('<image-slot> ingest failed:', err);
      }

    _setError(msg) {
      if (this._err) { this._err.remove(); this._err = null; }
      if (!msg) return;
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'err'; d.textContent = msg;
      this.shadowRoot.appendChild(d);
      this._err = d;
      setTimeout(() => { if (this._err === d) { d.remove(); this._err = null; } }, 3000);
    }

    _reframes() {
      return this.hasAttribute('data-filled');
    }

    _releaseMask(settled) {
      if (
        !this._swapGen &&
        !this._loadPending &&
        (settled || this._img.complete)
      ) {
        this.removeAttribute('data-swapping');
      }

    _geom() {
      const iw = this._img.naturalWidth, ih = this._img.naturalHeight;
      const fw = this.clientWidth, fh = this.clientHeight;
      if (!iw || !ih || !fw || !fh) return null;
      const contain = (this.getAttribute('fit') || 'cover').toLowerCase() === 'contain';
      const base = contain
        ? Math.min(fw / iw, fh / ih)
        : Math.max(fw / iw, fh / ih);
      return { iw, ih, fw, fh, base };
    }

    _clampView() {
      const g = this._geom();
      if (!g) return;
      const mx = Math.max(0, (g.iw * g.base * this._view.s / g.fw - 1) * 50);
      const my = Math.max(0, (g.ih * g.base * this._view.s / g.fh - 1) * 50);
      this._view.x = Math.max(-mx, Math.min(mx, this._view.x));
      this._view.y = Math.max(-my, Math.min(my, this._view.y));
    }

    _applyView() {
      const g = this._geom();
      if (this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) {
        let onTop = false;
        try { onTop = this._ctl.matches(':popover-open'); } catch {}
        if (onTop) {
          const r = this.getBoundingClientRect();
          this._ctl.style.left = (r.right - 8) + 'px';
          this._ctl.style.top = (r.top + 8) + 'px';
        }
      }
      if (!g) {
        const contain = (this.getAttribute('fit') || 'cover').toLowerCase() === 'contain';
        this._img.style.width = '100%';
        this._img.style.height = '100%';
        this._img.style.left = '50%';
        this._img.style.top = '50%';
        this._img.style.objectFit = contain ? 'contain' : 'cover';
        return;
      }
      const k = g.base * this._view.s;
      const w = (g.iw * k / g.fw * 100) + '%';
      const h = (g.ih * k / g.fh * 100) + '%';
      const l = (50 + this._view.x) + '%';
      const t = (50 + this._view.y) + '%';
      this._img.style.width = w; this._img.style.height = h;
      this._img.style.left = l; this._img.style.top = t;
      this._img.style.objectFit = '';
      if (this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) {
        const r = this.getBoundingClientRect();
        const sx = g.fw ? r.width / g.fw : 1;
        const sy = g.fh ? r.height / g.fh : 1;
        this._spill.style.width = (g.iw * k * sx) + 'px';
        this._spill.style.height = (g.ih * k * sy) + 'px';
        this._spill.style.left = (r.left + (50 + this._view.x) / 100 * r.width) + 'px';
        this._spill.style.top = (r.top + (50 + this._view.y) / 100 * r.height) + 'px';
      }
    }

    _commitView() {
      const v = { s: this._view.s, x: this._view.x, y: this._view.y };
      if (this._userUrl) v.u = this._userUrl;
      if (this.id) setSlot(this.id, v);
      else { this._local = v; }
    }

    _render() {
      const mask = this.getAttribute('mask');
      const shape = (this.getAttribute('shape') || 'rounded').toLowerCase();
      let radius = '';
      if (shape === 'circle') radius = '50%';
      else if (shape === 'pill') radius = '9999px';
      else if (shape === 'rounded') {
        const n = parseFloat(this.getAttribute('radius'));
        radius = (Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 12) + 'px';
      }
      this._frame.style.borderRadius = mask ? '' : radius;
      this._frame.style.clipPath = mask || '';
      this._ring.style.borderRadius = mask ? '' : radius;
      this._ring.style.display = mask ? 'none' : '';

      const editable = !!(window.omelette && window.omelette.writeFile);
      this.toggleAttribute('data-editable', editable);
      this._sub.style.display = editable ? '' : 'none';

      let stored = this.id ? getSlot(this.id) : this._local;
      if (stored && stored.u && !/^data:image\//i.test(stored.u)) stored = null;
      const srcAttr = this.getAttribute('src') || '';
      this._userUrl = (stored && stored.u) || null;
      const url = this._userUrl || srcAttr;
      if (!this.hasAttribute('data-reframe')) {
        this._view = {
          s: stored && Number.isFinite(stored.s) ? clampS(stored.s) : 1,
          x: stored && Number.isFinite(stored.x) ? stored.x : 0,
          y: stored && Number.isFinite(stored.y) ? stored.y : 0,
        };
      }
      this._cap.textContent = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Drop an image';
      const credit = (this.getAttribute('credit') || '').trim();
      const attrError = !!(
        !credit && !this._userUrl && srcAttr && isUnsplashHost(srcAttr)
      );
      this.toggleAttribute('data-attribution-error', attrError);
      if (url && !attrError) {
        const prev = this._img.getAttribute('src');
        if (prev !== url) {
          if (prev || this._hidShowing) this.setAttribute('data-swapping', '');
          this._loadPending = true;
          this._img.src = url;
          this._ghost.src = url;
        } else {
          this._releaseMask();
        }
        this._hidShowing = false;
        this._img.style.display = 'block';
        this._empty.style.display = 'none';
        this.setAttribute('data-filled', '');
        this._clampView();
        this._applyView();
      } else {
        this.removeAttribute('data-swapping');
        this._loadPending = false;
        this._hidShowing = attrError && !!this._img.getAttribute('src');
        this._img.style.display = 'none';
        this._img.removeAttribute('src');
        this._ghost.removeAttribute('src');
        this._empty.style.display = attrError ? 'none' : 'flex';
        this.removeAttribute('data-filled');
      }

      const showCredit = !!(url && credit && !this._userUrl && !attrError);
      this._credit.textContent = '';
      if (showCredit) {
        let href = '';
        const rawHref = this.getAttribute('credit-href') || '';
        if (rawHref) {
          try {
            const u = new URL(rawHref, document.baseURI);
            if (u.protocol === 'http:' || u.protocol === 'https:') {
              href = withReferral(u.href);
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        const mkLink = (text, linkHref) => {
          const a = document.createElement('a');
          a.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
          a.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
          a.setAttribute('href', linkHref);
          a.textContent = text;
          return a;
        };
        const m = /^Photo by (.+) on Unsplash$/.exec(credit);
        if (m) {
          this._credit.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Photo by '));
          this._credit.appendChild(
            href ? mkLink(m[1], href) : document.createTextNode(m[1])
          );
          this._credit.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' on '));
          this._credit.appendChild(mkLink('Unsplash', UNSPLASH_HOMEPAGE_HREF));
        } else if (href) {
          this._credit.appendChild(mkLink(credit, href));
        } else {
          this._credit.textContent = credit;
        }
      }
      this.toggleAttribute('data-credit', showCredit);
    }
  }

  if (!customElements.get('image-slot')) {
    customElements.define('image-slot', ImageSlot);
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
// abv2.js inlined
(function () {
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ---------- 2. timeline: n/u wave ---------- */
  var EVENTS = [
    { y: '2013', t: 'Company founded', k: 'u', d: 'Incorporated 2013 - the directory era of local search.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2014', t: 'Platform launch', k: 'n', d: 'February 2014: business data synced across the directory ecosystem.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2015', t: '500K businesses', k: 'u', d: 'Half a million businesses managed on the platform.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2016', t: 'Mobile-first sync', k: 'n', d: 'Real-time sync for mobile map cards and voice assistants.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2017', t: 'Series A', k: 'u', d: 'Led by Vertex Ventures - part of the Temasek network.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2018', t: '1M businesses', k: 'n', d: 'One million businesses powered by Synup.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2019', t: 'Reviews platform', k: 'u', d: 'Monitoring, response and review generation across networks.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2020', t: 'Remote operations', k: 'n', d: 'Platform scaled for remote-first agency workflows.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2021', t: '2M businesses', k: 'u', d: 'Two million businesses managed worldwide.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2022', t: 'Social beta', k: 'n', d: 'Multi-location social scheduling enters private beta.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2023', t: 'Social publishing', k: 'u', d: 'Scheduling and publishing per location, from one place.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2024', t: 'Clientjoy + OptimoRank', k: 'n', d: 'Two acquisitions: agency client operations (Jan) and local SEO (Feb).', url: '#' },
    { y: '2025', t: 'Visibility Score', k: 'u', d: 'One measure across search, maps and answer engines.', url: '#' },
    { y: '2026', t: 'MCP server', k: 'n', d: 'Agents read and act on business data directly.', url: '#' }
  ];
  var SVGNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  function el(n, a) { var e = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, n); for (var k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]); return e; }
  function wrap(t) {
    if (t.length <= 17) return [t];
    var w = t.split(' '), a = '', b = '';
    w.forEach(function (x) { if ((a + ' ' + x).trim().length <= 17 && !b) a = (a + ' ' + x).trim(); else b = (b + ' ' + x).trim(); });
    return b ? [a, b] : [a];
  }

  (function waveTimeline() {
    var svg = document.getElementById('ab2-wave');
    var vert = document.querySelector('.ab2-vlist');
    var cap = document.getElementById('ab2-tl-cap');
    if (!svg) return;
    var W = 1800, H = 260, base = 132, r = 42, pad = 52;
    var span = W - pad * 2, step = span / EVENTS.length;
    var xs = EVENTS.map(function (_, i) { return pad + step * (i + 0.5); });
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H);

    var d = 'M0 ' + base;
    xs.forEach(function (x, i) {
      var up = EVENTS[i].k === 'n';
      d += ' L' + (x - r) + ' ' + base + ' A' + r + ' ' + r + ' 0 0 ' + (up ? 1 : 0) + ' ' + (x + r) + ' ' + base;
    });
    d += ' L' + W + ' ' + base;

    svg.appendChild(el('path', { d: d, class: 'path-bg' }));
    var fg = el('path', { d: d, class: 'path-fg' });
    svg.appendChild(fg);

    var LINK_D = 'M18 13v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6M15 3h6v6M10 14L21 3';

    var nodes = EVENTS.map(function (ev, i) {
      var up = ev.k === 'n', ay = up ? base - r : base + r;
      var g = el('g', { class: 'nd' + (ev.k === 'u' ? ' is-struct' : ''), tabindex: '0', role: 'listitem', 'aria-label': ev.y + ' - ' + ev.t + '. ' + ev.d });
      g.appendChild(el('circle', { cx: xs[i], cy: ay, r: 5.5 }));
      var ty = up ? ay - 34 : ay + 26;
      var yr = el('text', { x: xs[i], y: ty, class: 'yr', 'text-anchor': 'middle' });
      yr.textContent = ev.y;
      g.appendChild(yr);
      var lines = wrap(ev.t);
      lines.forEach(function (line, li) {
        var ti = el('text', { x: xs[i], y: ty + 17 + li * 15, class: 'ti', 'text-anchor': 'middle' });
        ti.textContent = line;
        g.appendChild(ti);
      });
      // subtle link icon
      var lkA = el('a', { href: ev.url, target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' });
      var lkSvg = el('svg', { x: xs[i] - 4.5, y: ty + 17 + lines.length * 15 + 2, width: '9', height: '9', viewBox: '0 0 24 24', class: 'lk' });
      lkSvg.appendChild(el('path', { d: LINK_D }));
      lkA.appendChild(lkSvg);
      g.appendChild(lkA);

      function hot() { if (cap) cap.textContent = ev.y + ' - ' + ev.d; }
      function cool() { if (cap) cap.textContent = cap.dataset.def || ''; }
      g.addEventListener('mouseenter', hot);
      g.addEventListener('mouseleave', cool);
      g.addEventListener('focus', hot);
      g.addEventListener('blur', cool);
      svg.appendChild(g);
      return g;
    });

    if (vert) {
      EVENTS.forEach(function (ev) {
        var row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'ab2-vrow' + (ev.k === 'u' ? ' is-struct' : '');
        row.innerHTML = '<div class="yr"></div><div class="ti"></div><div class="ds"></div>';
        row.querySelector('.yr').textContent = ev.y;
        row.querySelector('.ti').textContent = ev.t;
        vert.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    var len = fg.getTotalLength();
    fg.style.strokeDasharray = len;
    function paint(p) {
      fg.style.strokeDashoffset = len * (1 - p);
      nodes.forEach(function (g, i) { g.classList.toggle('is-on', p >= (xs[i] + r * 0.4) / W); });
    }
    if (reduce) { paint(1); return; }
    paint(0);
    var wrapEl = svg.closest('.ab2-wave-wrap') || svg;
    function onScroll() {
      var b = wrapEl.getBoundingClientRect(), vh = window.innerHeight;
      var p = (vh * 0.9 - b.top) / (b.height + vh * 0.35);
      paint(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p)));
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
    onScroll();
  })();

  /* 3. presence map */
  (function presenceMap() {
    var host = document.getElementById('ab2-map');
    if (!host || typeof d3 === 'undefined' || typeof topojson === 'undefined') return;
    var W = 720, H = 400;
    var cvs = document.createElement('canvas');
    host.insertBefore(cvs, host.firstChild);
    var OFFICES = [
      { id: 'berlin', lon: 13.405, lat: 52.52 },
      { id: 'newyork', lon: -74.006, lat: 40.713 },
      { id: 'bengaluru', lon: 77.595, lat: 12.972 }
    ];

    fetch('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-110m.json')
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (topo) {
        var fc = topojson.feature(topo, topo.objects.countries);
        fc.features = fc.features.filter(function (f) { return f.id !== '010'; });
        var proj = d3.geoNaturalEarth1().fitSize([W, H], fc);

        var mask = document.createElement('canvas');
        mask.width = W; mask.height = H;
        var mc = mask.getContext('2d');
        mc.fillStyle = '#fff';
        d3.geoPath(proj, mc)(fc);
        mc.fill();
        var px = mc.getImageData(0, 0, W, H).data;

        var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        cvs.width = W * dpr; cvs.height = H * dpr;
        var ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,162,158,.55)';
        var stepPx = 5.5;
        for (var y = 3; y < H; y += stepPx) {
          for (var x = 3; x < W; x += stepPx) {
            var o = ((y | 0) * W + (x | 0)) * 4 + 3;
            if (px[o] > 120) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 1.05, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); }
          }
        }

        OFFICES.forEach(function (o) {
          var p = proj([o.lon, o.lat]);
          var mk = host.querySelector('.ab2-mk[data-id="' + o.id + '"]');
          if (!mk || !p) return;
          mk.style.left = (p[0] / W * 100) + '%';
          mk.style.top = (p[1] / H * 100) + '%';
          mk.hidden = false;
        });
      })
      .catch(function () { host.classList.add('is-nomap'); });

    var mks = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.ab2-mk'));
    var offs = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.ab2-off'));
    function setHot(id) {
      mks.forEach(function (m) {
        m.classList.toggle('is-hot', !!id && m.dataset.id === id);
        m.classList.toggle('is-cold', !!id && m.dataset.id !== id);
      });
      offs.forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('is-cold', !!id && o.dataset.id !== id); });
    }
    mks.concat(offs).forEach(function (n) {
      n.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { setHot(n.dataset.id); });
      n.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { setHot(null); });
      n.addEventListener('focus', function () { setHot(n.dataset.id); });
      n.addEventListener('blur', function () { setHot(null); });
    });
  })();
})();

</footer><script type="module" src="/_astro/CookieConsent.astro_astro_type_script_index_0_lang.DR3l4KNX.js"></script><script src="https://js.chatlio.com/widget.js" async></script><chatlio-widget widgetid="8a93ddbb-8d4e-46d6-5476-51861e987d9a"></chatlio-widget><style>
      /*
        Typeface.

        Chatlio ships two font rules: system-ui on #chatlio-widget with
        !important, and Roboto on its buttons, inputs and textareas - which is
        why the offline form's fields and Send button read differently again
        from the rest of the widget.

        The site is Inter, already loaded at 400-800, so the widget can use it
        without pulling another font file.

        Scoped with html #chatlio-widget rather than #chatlio-widget alone
        because Chatlio injects its stylesheet at runtime, after this block.
        Equal specificity would lose on source order, so this needs to be one
        step higher. The universal selector is what catches the button/input
        rule as well, and it stays harmless by being scoped inside the widget.
      */
      html #chatlio-widget,
      html #chatlio-widget * {
        font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif !important;
      }

      /*
        Brand colours.

        titleColor in the dashboard only reaches the launcher and the header
        bar. Chatlio's own stylesheet hardcodes #4041f4 on every button and on
        the visitor's own message bubbles, so without these the Start button,
        the offline Send button and every message a visitor types stay indigo
        inside an otherwise orange widget.

        Buttons take orange fill with ink text - 6.37:1, and the combination the
        design system names explicitly for "buttons, pills, badges".

        The visitor's own message bubbles take ink rather than orange. A
        transcript is many bubbles, and orange on every one of them is the
        failure the design system warns about: "if everything is orange,
        nothing is". Ink on white is 17.5:1 and reads as the calmer half of the
        conversation.

        The v5 widget is light DOM and the account has widgetCSSCompatibility
        enabled, so id-scoped selectors are enough.
      */
      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget button,
      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget button:hover {
        background-color: #FF731E !important;
        color: #1C1917 !important;
      }

      /*
        Form fields.

        Chatlio types into #677583 and hints in #757575 - two greys close enough
        that what a visitor has actually typed is hard to tell from the
        placeholder they have not. On the offline form, which is the only way to
        reach us for seven hours a day, that reads as a field that ignored the
        input.

        Typed text goes to ink, placeholders to muted. The gap between them is
        the point: 17.5:1 against 4.9:1 makes entered text unmistakably
        different from a prompt.
      */
      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget input,
      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget textarea {
        color: #1C1917 !important;
      }

      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget input::placeholder,
      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget textarea::placeholder {
        color: #6B7280 !important;
      }

      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-message.chatlio-message-from-me .chatlio-message-body {
        background-color: #1C1917 !important;
        color: #FFFFFF !important;
      }

      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-btn__spinner-center {
        background: #1C1917 !important;
      }

      /*
        Launcher glyph.

        Chatlio paints the closed launcher's chat icon as a remote SVG
        background whose fill is baked in as #FFF. That was invisible while the
        launcher was blue, but white on orange is 2.72:1 - below the 3:1 WCAG
        1.4.11 needs for a meaningful UI icon, and the exact pairing the design
        system rules out. The launcher is the most-seen part of the widget, so
        it is the last place to carry a contrast failure.

        Same icon, same geometry, redrawn with an ink fill: 6.37:1. Inlined as a
        data URI because the fill lives inside the SVG and no CSS property can
        reach into a background-image to recolour it.

        Only background-image is overridden. The orange comes from titleColor as
        an inline background-color, and background-size stays with Chatlio.

        Tied to .chatlio-bottom-right, matching widgetAlignment. If alignment
        ever moves to bottom-left, Chatlio swaps in button-left.svg and this
        rule stops matching - the glyph would go back to white rather than break
        visibly, so check it if alignment changes.
      */
      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget.chatlio-closed .chatlio-title-bar.chatlio-title-bar-button.chatlio-bottom-right {
        background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='32' height='33' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cpath d='M16 32.712c-8.837 0-16-7.163-16-16s7.163-16 16-16h.356C24.996.712 32 7.716 32 16.356v16.356H16zM16 30h13V16.711C29 9.691 23.309 4 16.289 4H16C8.82 4 3 9.82 3 17s5.82 13 13 13zm-.021-5.331a10.974 10.974 0 01-7.429-2.903 1.675 1.675 0 01-.132-2.32 1.567 1.567 0 012.255-.135 7.829 7.829 0 005.306 2.072 7.832 7.832 0 005.364-2.126 1.567 1.567 0 012.257.113 1.675 1.675 0 01-.11 2.32c-2.043 1.904-4.698 2.979-7.511 2.979z' fill='%231C1917' fill-rule='evenodd'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      }

      /*
        Launcher close icon.

        Same problem as the launcher glyph, different asset and different state:
        while the panel is open the launcher shows x.svg, also filled #FFF, also
        2.72:1 on orange.

        Only .chatlio-widget-minimize is retargeted - the launcher's own close.
        The panel header keeps its grey x-dark.svg, which sits on white and is
        fine as it is.
      */
      #chatlio-widget .chatlio-widget-minimize {
        background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='16' height='16' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cpath d='M9.414 8l6.293-6.293A1 1 0 1014.293.293L8 6.586 1.707.293A1 1 0 00.293 1.707L6.586 8 .293 14.292a1 1 0 001.414 1.415L8 9.414l6.293 6.293a1 1 0 101.414-1.415L9.414 8z' fill='%231C1917'/%3E%3C/svg%3E") !important;
      }

      /*
        Mobile spacing.

        The launcher is 100x100 and sits flush in the corner on phones, where it
        lands on the demo form's fields. Insetting it keeps it off the very
        corner and away from the edge of full-width inputs.

        Done in CSS rather than through _chatlio.setEdgeSpacing(). That method is
        documented but the v5 loader only queues
        configure/identify/track/show/hide/isShown/isOnline/page/open/showOrHide -
        calling it is a silent no-op.

        !important is needed, unusually. Chatlio's own @media (max-width:480px)
        block hardcodes "bottom:0; right:0; left:auto" on
        .chatlio-widget.chatlio-bottom-right. That selector is lower specificity
        than the one here, so this should win on the cascade - but it does not,
        and without !important the launcher settles flush in the corner. left is
        pinned to auto because the same block also sets left:0, which would
        otherwise fight the right offset.

        A floating launcher always overlays something; this reduces the
        collision, it does not remove it.

        Size. Chatlio's launcher is 100x100 - unusually large for a phone, and
        big enough to cover most of a full-width form field it shares vertical
        space with (measured: it sat over the right 82px of the contact form's
        Work email field at 375px). Scaling the closed launcher to a standard
        ~62px FAB cuts the covered area by ~62% and is the proportionate fix for
        small screens. transform-origin is bottom-right so it shrinks into the
        same inset corner. Scoped to the closed state so the open chat panel is
        never scaled down.
      */
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        #chatlio-widget-container.chatlio-closed,
        #chatlio-widget-container:not(.chatlio-open) {
          bottom: 10px !important;
          right: 6px !important;
          left: auto !important;
          transform: scale(0.62) !important;
          transform-origin: bottom right !important;
        }

        /* Keep the site-owned launcher from covering consent choices. It
           returns as soon as the visitor closes the consent bar. */
        html.show--consent body.week3-candidate-page #chatlio-widget-container.chatlio-closed,
        html.show--consent body.week3-candidate-page #chatlio-widget-container:not(.chatlio-open) {
          visibility: hidden !important;
          pointer-events: none !important;
        }
      }
    </style><script>(function(){const locale = "es";

      (function () {
        /* Chatlio queues API calls made before it initialises, so nothing here
           needs to wait for the widget to be ready. */
        window._chatlio = window._chatlio || [];

        function readCookie(name) {
          var m = document.cookie.match(
            new RegExp('(^|;\\s*)' + name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '=([^;]*)')
          );
          return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[2]) : '';
        }

        /* Where this visitor actually came from.

           UTMs only exist on the URL of the landing page, which is usually not
           the page someone opens chat on, so the current query string alone
           would report "none" for most real chats. The attribution script's
           first-touch cookie survives the whole session and is the only thing
           that still knows. Both are sent: whichever is present wins. */
        function attribution() {
          var out = {};
          try {
            var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
            ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content', 'gclid'].forEach(
              function (k) { if (q.get(k)) out[k] = q.get(k); }
            );
            var ft = readCookie('cf_48083_first_touch');
            if (ft) {
              try {
                var parsed = JSON.parse(ft);
                if (parsed.landing_page) out.landing_page = parsed.landing_page;
              } catch (e) { /* cookie shape changed - not worth failing chat over */ }
            }
            if (document.referrer && document.referrer.indexOf(location.host) === -1) {
              out.referrer = document.referrer;
            }
          } catch (e) { /* attribution is a nice-to-have, never a blocker */ }
          return out;
        }

        /* Analytics. Mirrors the delegated CTA tracking in Base.astro so chat
           sits alongside "Free Trial Clicked" and "Contact Sales Clicked"
           rather than in a scheme of its own. */
        function track(event, props) {
          var p = Object.assign({ page: location.pathname, locale: locale }, props || {});
          try { if (window.plausible) window.plausible(event, { props: p }); } catch (e) {}
          try {
            if (window.dataLayer) {
              window.dataLayer.push(Object.assign({ event: 'chatlio_' + event.replace(/\s+/g, '_').toLowerCase() }, p));
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        function on(name, fn) { document.addEventListener('chatlio.' + name, fn); }

        /* Identity is only sent once the visitor has given it to the pre-chat
           form. Chatlio already puts that name and email on the Slack card by
           itself - re-sending them here would risk overwriting a working flow -
           so the same values go back untouched and the attribution keys ride
           along as extra fields. */
        on('preChatInfoSubmitted', function (e) {
          var d = (e && (e.detail || e.data)) || {};
          if (!d.email) return;
          try {
            window._chatlio.identify(d.email, Object.assign(
              { name: d.name || '', email: d.email, page: location.pathname, locale: locale },
              attribution()
            ));
          } catch (err) { /* never let enrichment break the chat itself */ }
          track('Chat Identified');
        });

        on('expanded', function () { track('Chat Opened'); });

        on('questionGroupAnswerSelected', function () {
          // Never send answer text or free-form chat content to analytics.
          track('Chat Routed');
        });

        on('firstMessageSent', function () { track('Chat Started'); });
        on('conversationEnded', function () { track('Chat Ended'); });

        /*
          Offline capture.

          Chatlio's offline form posts to Slack and stops there. The widget is
          on an operating hours schedule, so that is a predictable window every
          day in which a lead arrives with no CRM record and no attribution -
          and no trace at all if nobody happens to scroll the channel.

          Forwarding to /api/lead puts those in the same pipeline as the site's
          forms. That endpoint fans out to SalesHQ, Slack and email
          independently, and it treats unknown keys as pass-through, so the
          attribution fields survive.

          Fails silently and deliberately: the visitor has already been told
          their message was sent, and Chatlio has it. A failure here must not
          surface an error for something that did in fact get through.
        */
        var forwarded = false;
        on('offlineMessageSent', function (e) {
          var d = (e && (e.detail || e.data)) || {};
          if (forwarded || !d.email) return;
          forwarded = true;

          /* /api/lead validates firstName and email. Chatlio collects one free
             text "name", so split it rather than send an empty firstName and
             have the endpoint reject a real lead. */
          var name = (d.name || '').trim();
          var first = name.split(/\s+/)[0] || 'Website';
          var last = name.split(/\s+/).slice(1).join(' ');

          var payload = Object.assign({
            firstName: first,
            lastName: last,
            email: d.email,
            message: d.message || '',
            requestType: 'Live chat (offline)',
            source: 'chatlio-offline',
            page: location.pathname,
            locale: locale
          }, attribution());

          try {
            fetch('/api/lead', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify(payload),
              keepalive: true
            }).catch(function () {});
          } catch (err) {}

          track('Chat Offline Message Sent');
        });

      })();

<!-- Plausible journey events: delegated CTA click tracking.
     Primary: data-track="trial" attribute on CTAs (self-documenting, works
     for any href). Fallback: href matching for CTAs that haven't been tagged
     yet. Capture phase so stopPropagation on the demo page can't swallow it.

     data-track="trial"     → fires "Trial: CTA Click"
     data-placement="hero"  → props.placement (hero|nav|footer|section)
     No data-placement      → inferred from DOM ancestors               -->
<script>
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href],button') : null;
    if (!el) return;
    var href = el.getAttribute('href') || '';
    var track = el.getAttribute('data-track');

    /* ── Placement: explicit attribute wins, then DOM inference ── */
    var placement = el.getAttribute('data-placement')
      || (el.closest('.mn-nav') ? 'nav'
        : el.closest('.sf-footer,.page_liner-block') ? 'footer'
        : el.closest('[class*="hero"],.sh-cta,.ph-hero,.ov-hero,.pp-hero') ? 'hero'
        : 'section');

    /* ── Trial CTA ── */
    var isTrial = track === 'trial'
      || href.indexOf('ai.synup.com/signup') !== -1
      || href.indexOf('synupbot.com/signup') !== -1;

    if (isTrial) {
      plausible('Trial: CTA Click', {
        props: { location: location.pathname, placement: placement }
      });
      return;
    }

    /* ── Sales / Contact CTAs (unchanged logic) ── */
    var props = { page: location.pathname, section: placement };

    if (/(^|\/)((es|fr|de)\/)?(book-a-demo(-social)?|contact-sales)(\/|$|\?|#)/.test(href)) {
      plausible('Contact Sales Clicked', { props: props });
    } else if (/(^|\/)((es|fr|de)\/)?contact(\/|$|\?|#)/.test(href)) {
      plausible('Contact Clicked', { props: props });
    }
  }, true);
</script>

.mn-panel-host { position: relative; }
.mn-panel {
  display: none; background: var(--mn-white);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--mn-line);
}
.mn-panel.is-open { display: block; }
.mn-panel-inner {
  max-width: var(--mn-maxw); margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 1.75rem 2.25rem;
}

/* Panel grids */
.mn-panel-grid { display: grid; gap: 2.5rem; }
.mn-cols-agent    { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.mn-cols-product  { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.mn-cols-solutions{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.mn-cols-resources{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }

.mn-group-heading {
  font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-bottom: 1rem;
}
.mn-item-list { display: grid; gap: .25rem; }
.mn-mega-item {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.25rem 1fr; gap: .875rem;
  align-items: start; padding: .625rem; border-radius: 10px;
  transition: background .12s ease; text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
}
.mn-mega-item:active { background: var(--mn-bg-soft); }   /* tap feedback; :hover is in the hover-only block */
.mn-mega-tile {
  width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--mn-bg-soft);
  display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--mn-navy); flex: none;
  transition: background .12s ease, color .12s ease;
}
.mn-mega-tile svg { width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; }
.mn-mega-text { min-width: 0; }                   /* prevents an unbreakable label from overflowing */
.mn-mega-text .mn-mt-label {
  font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--mn-navy); line-height: 1.3;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
}
.mn-mt-desc { font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--mn-muted); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: .125rem; }
.mn-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
  font-size: .625rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em;
  /* --mn-blue (the deep accent, #C2410C) rather than --mn-orange (#FF731E).
     White on bright orange is 2.7:1, and this pill is 10px bold, so it is not
     large text and needs 4.5:1 to clear WCAG AA. The deep accent takes the same
     white text to 5.2:1. That is what the two orange tokens are for. */
  color: #fff; background: var(--mn-blue); border-radius: 200px;
  padding: .125rem .4375rem; line-height: 1.4;
}

/* Feature card */
.mn-feature-card {
  background: var(--mn-bg-soft); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; align-self: start;
  border: 1px solid var(--mn-line);
}
.mn-fc-media {
  position: relative; border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden; height: 8rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1C1917, #C2410C);
  display: grid; place-items: center;
}
.mn-fc-play {
  width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--mn-navy);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}
.mn-fc-play svg { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; margin-left: 2px; }
.mn-fc-eyebrow { font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--mn-muted); }
.mn-fc-title { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-navy); line-height: 1.3; }
.mn-fc-link { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--mn-blue); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .375rem; }
.mn-fc-link svg { width: .9375rem; height: .9375rem; }

/* Suite grid (Product v2) */
.mn-suite-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3.5rem; }
.mn-suite { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }
.mn-suite-divider { position: relative; }
.mn-suite-divider::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: -1.75rem; width: 1px; background: var(--mn-line); }
.mn-anchor { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 1.5rem; }
.mn-anchor-card {
  position: relative; display: block; border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.375rem 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--mn-line); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF1E8 0%, #FCFBF9 100%);
  overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow .15s ease, transform .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
  text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
}
.mn-anchor-card::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -10%; width: 14rem; height: 14rem;
  border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,115,30,.15), transparent 68%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.mn-anchor-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .625rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
.mn-anchor-eyebrow { font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--mn-blue); }
.mn-anchor-title { position: relative; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-navy); line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.mn-anchor-sub { position: relative; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--mn-muted); line-height: 1.45; margin-top: .375rem; max-width: 26rem; }
.mn-anchor-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .375rem; margin-top: .875rem; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mn-blue); }
.mn-anchor-link svg { width: .9375rem; height: .9375rem; transition: transform .15s ease; }

/* ---------- Hover states: real pointers only (kills sticky-hover on touch) ---------- */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .mn-link:hover { background: var(--mn-bg-soft); color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-signin:hover { color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-btn-primary:hover { background: #292524; }
  .mn-mega-item:hover { background: var(--mn-bg-soft); }
  .mn-mega-item:hover .mn-mega-tile { background: #FFF1E8; color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-mega-item:hover .mn-mt-label { color: var(--mn-blue); }
  .mn-anchor-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -14px rgba(194,65,12,.35); transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--mn-line); }
  .mn-anchor-card:hover .mn-anchor-link { color: var(--mn-blue-hover); }
  .mn-anchor-card:hover .mn-anchor-link svg { transform: translateX(3px); }
}

/* ---------- Mobile ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .mn-links { display: none; }
  .mn-signin { display: none; }
  .mn-burger { display: flex; align-items: center; }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-links {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch;
    position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 9998;
    background: var(--mn-white); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mn-line);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
    padding: 1rem 1.75rem;
    /* env(): menu edges clear the notch; bottom clears the home indicator */
    padding-left:  max(1.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-left));
    padding-right: max(1.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-right));
    padding-bottom: max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    /* tall menu scrolls inside the viewport instead of hiding behind the browser chrome.
       dvh handles the iOS URL bar; the vh line above is the fallback for old browsers. */
    max-height: calc(100vh - 4rem);
    max-height: calc(100dvh - 4rem);
    overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-burger .mn-menu { display: none; }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-burger .mn-x { display: block; }
  .mn-panel { position: relative; }
  .mn-panel-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .mn-cols-agent, .mn-cols-product, .mn-cols-solutions, .mn-cols-resources { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .mn-suite-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .mn-suite-divider::before { display: none; }
  .mn-feature-card { display: none; }
  /* Mobile menu: show items two-up so the list is shorter to scan/scroll.
     Drop the per-item descriptions in this compact 2-col view. */
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-item-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .25rem .75rem; }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-mega-item { padding: .5rem .5rem; }
  .mn-nav.is-open .mn-mt-desc { display: none; }
}

<script>
(function(){
  var nav = document.querySelector("[data-mn]");
  if (!nav) return;
  var links = nav.querySelectorAll("[data-mn-link]");
  var panels = nav.querySelectorAll("[data-mn-panel]");
  var burger = nav.querySelector("[data-mn-burger]");
  var host = nav.querySelector(".mn-panel-host");
  var active = null;
  var lastInputWasPointer = false;

  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(){ lastInputWasPointer = true; }, true);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(){ lastInputWasPointer = false; }, true);

  function open(name) {
    panels.forEach(function(p){ p.classList.toggle("is-open", p.getAttribute("data-mn-panel") === name); });
    links.forEach(function(l){ l.classList.toggle("is-open", l.getAttribute("data-mn-link") === name); });
    active = name;
  }
  function closeAll() {
    panels.forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove("is-open"); });
    links.forEach(function(l){ l.classList.remove("is-open"); });
    active = null;
  }

  // Only bind hover-open on real pointers. On touch, a synthesized mouseenter would
  // open the panel and the following click would toggle it shut ("won't open" bug).
  var canHover = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and (min-width: 1025px)").matches;

  links.forEach(function(l){
    if (canHover) l.addEventListener("mouseenter", function(){ open(l.getAttribute("data-mn-link")); });
    l.addEventListener("focus", function(){
      // A tap focuses before it clicks. Let the click open the panel so the
      // newly restored Resources item remains reachable on touch devices.
      if (!lastInputWasPointer) open(l.getAttribute("data-mn-link"));
    });
    l.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var name = l.getAttribute("data-mn-link");
      if (active === name) closeAll(); else open(name);
    });
  });

  if (canHover) host.addEventListener("mouseleave", closeAll);

  if (burger) {
    burger.addEventListener("click", function(){ nav.classList.toggle("is-open"); closeAll(); });
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", function(e){
    if (!nav.contains(e.target)) { closeAll(); nav.classList.remove("is-open"); }
  });
})();
